onset.Description: Time of the event in run time: seconds since the movement start of the trial (sample 0 of the motion files); negative before the movement start.

trial_type.Description: Event type. Touch events are copied from the trajectory file: begin and lift events are logged independently and need not pair up (several fingers, or a touch that began before the trial); the last object lift often follows trial_end.

Levels.trial_start: the path appears on the screen
Levels.movement_start: first end-effector sample (the object starts to follow the finger)
Levels.object_touch_begin: a touch begins on the object
Levels.object_touch_lift: a touch on the object is lifted
Levels.other_touch_begin: a touch begins elsewhere on the screen
Levels.other_touch_lift: a touch elsewhere on the screen is lifted
Levels.trial_end: end of the trial as logged by the game

x.Description: Touch or end-effector position: horizontal touch position on the screen; origin at the screen centre, positive to the participant's right (logged direction). n/a for trial_start and trial_end.

y.Description: Touch or end-effector position: vertical touch position on the screen; origin at the screen centre, positive upward (logged direction). n/a for trial_start and trial_end.
